messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up: BeaconHealth needs a short-term egress allowlist + regional QPS lift for their APAC pilot tomorrow AM. They said this is to prevent 429s during a staged cutover. @leo_ops can you own it?

leo_ops: I can. Request exact CIDRs, target QPS, region and duration. Also need business justification for the infra ticket.

maya_cs: CIDRs: 18.205.33.0/24, 18.205.33.128/25. Region: ap-southeast-1. Current baseline 40 QPS -> request 250 QPS for 48 hours. Reason: final smoke tests + customer-driven rollout. They also asked about warming prefix caches.

anya_eng: I'll prepare the rate-limit and routing change, add an automated revoke at 48h. Staging command I used previously: ``redwoodctl customers patch --id beacon-health --allowlist 18.205.33.0/24,18.205.33.128/25 --qps 250 --region ap-southeast-1 --ttl 48h``

leo_ops: Nice. I'll apply to staging and run a scripted traffic burst. @maya_cs paste a sanitized prod payload for the runbook please.

maya_cs: Prod payload (sanitized): {"customer_id":"beacon-health","change":{"region":"ap-southeast-1","qps":250,"allowlist":["18.205.33.0/24","18.205.33.128/25"],"auto_revoke":"48h"},"requested_by":"maya_cs"}

infra-bot: infra-bot: change-request created (#CS-8221) by leo_ops - awaiting review

anya_eng: Staging applied; synthetic checks OK. Scheduling a 5-10m prod window at 09:30 UTC. Watchlist: QPS, 500s, p95/p99. Rollback if 500s > 0.8% or latency spike > baseline + 40ms.

leo_ops: Deployed at 09:31 UTC. Control plane returned revoke timestamp: 2026-03-28T09:31:00Z. CLI output trimmed in runbook.

maya_cs: Customer confirmed initial traffic flows, error rate stable (~0.15%), latency within acceptance. I'll trigger the KV pre-warm job for their top-10 prefixes.

rachel_ae: I'll mention the smooth ramp to the account and suggest a roadmap to Dedicated in our renewal outreach (renewal in ~33 days). Positive outcome here reduces churn risk.

maya_cs: Action items: 1) verify revoke fires after 48h (leo_ops), 2) add KB article for cache pre-warm + attach to ticket (maya_cs), 3) AE renewal note + usage snapshot (rachel_ae). Leaving thread open for confirms.
